title: Bilinear base change preserves algebroid colimits
statement: Let $\mathcal V,\mathcal W,\mathcal T$ be cocomplete monoidal infinity categories whose tensors preserve small colimits separately. Use [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. If $b:\mathcal V\times\mathcal W\to\mathcal T$ is a strong monoidal functor preserving small colimits separately, the bifunctor $(A,B)\mapsto b_*(A\boxtimes B)$ from $\operatorname{Algd}(\mathcal V)\times\operatorname{Algd}(\mathcal W)$ to $\operatorname{Algd}(\mathcal T)$ preserves small colimits separately. Here $A\boxtimes B$ has object space $X\times Y$ and mapping objects $(A(x,x'),B(y,y'))$, and $b_*$ composes its enrichment with $b$.
